summary: Provides utility functions for abbreviating absolute file paths by replacing the user's home directory with a tilde.
responsibilities: Replaces the system home directory path prefix with ~
Normalizes path separators to forward slashes for display purposes
Handles non-absolute and cross-device paths by returning them unchanged

symbols.name: formatHomePath
symbols.summary: Converts an absolute file path into a tilde-prefixed format if it resides within the home directory.
